title: HIG unenforced invariant audit

limitations: A source audit and focused probes cannot prove all invariants are found.
No production app transaction implementation or server validation was audited.
Native runtime behavior was inspected; the invariant probes run in jsdom or exercise pure helpers.
Host-owned policy assumptions are identified separately from implementation defects.

verification.regressionTests: tests/invariants.dom.test.tsx and tests/numeric-invariants.test.ts, plus native swap/provider and chart/confetti regression cases
verification.note: Original characterization probes have been replaced with acceptance regressions in the normal test suites.

validation.finalNativeRetest: passed after preserving original snap-point values in the memoized copy

priorTask.note: Existing docs GestureSheet New-tag edits were preserved.

findings.invariant: An asset is identified by chain and asset identity, not its display ticker.
findings.observed: swapAction classifies equal symbols as send before comparing chains. Different-chain USDC and same-chain assets sharing a symbol are both classified as send.
findings.enforcement: Define canonical asset and chain identities; compare them before selecting send, swap or bridge. Normalize numeric/string chain IDs at the boundary.

resolution.detail: Asset identity and normalized chain identity determine send/swap/bridge.

findings.invariant: A known zero balance is insufficient for a positive amount.
findings.observed: The balance check and limitToBalance guard run only when balance > 0. A zero-balance From asset with amount 1 can invoke onSubmit.
findings.enforcement: Distinguish unknown balance from finite zero. Validate nonnegative balances and compare every known balance against the requested units.

resolution.detail: Every known balance, including zero, participates in insufficiency checks.

findings.invariant: All entry paths obey the same precision and balance limits.
findings.observed: Keypad digits consult decimals and balance; web paste sanitizes the text but bypasses both guards. With decimals 2 and balance 5, pasting 99.1234 reports 99.1234.
findings.enforcement: Route keypad, paste, Max, Test and external resync through one amount normalization/validation function.

resolution.detail: All edits apply precision and balance caps; capped external resync reports the corrected amount.

findings.invariant: Once submitting is true, global amount handlers stop accepting edits.
findings.observed: The global keyboard/paste effect captures press/paste and submitting but does not depend on them. After false to true, a global digit still reports a changed amount.
findings.enforcement: Read current submission state through a ref/stable event callback, or refresh the registered handlers with all behavioral dependencies.

resolution.detail: Global input handlers always read current submission state.

findings.invariant: The reported transaction amount preserves the amount entered.
findings.observed: The string amount is converted through Number and trimNumber defaults to 8 decimals. 0.000000001 reports 0; 9007199254740993 becomes 9007199254740992. Token decimals can exceed 8.
findings.enforcement: Keep canonical decimal strings or base-unit integers through editing and callbacks. Restrict floating point conversion to display estimates.

resolution.detail: Bounded decimal-string arithmetic preserves token precision; floats are used only for visual estimates.

findings.invariant: A displayed unknown target cannot be submitted by default.
findings.observed: The readout treats NaN/Infinity as unknown, while TargetBlock only disables submission for value === null. NaN still invokes onSubmit.
findings.enforcement: Use the same finite-value predicate for display and default submit gating, with additional host rules for valid prices and position direction.

resolution.detail: Unknown and nonfinite targets cannot be submitted, including when submitDisabled is false.

findings.invariant: A provider used to override one property preserves the surrounding app environment.
findings.observed: A nested HIGProvider that changes only primaryColor resets locale/direction/density/reducedMotion defaults and drops feedback/onAccepted. Native also drops several font settings. Some other properties do inherit.
findings.enforcement: Choose and document a uniform inheritance policy, then inherit omitted properties or explicitly require complete root configuration. Preserve explicit false values.

resolution.detail: Nested providers inherit omitted environment, feedback and font settings.

findings.invariant: A component does not silently change controlled/uncontrolled ownership.
findings.observed: useControllable chooses ownership on every render. Removing value after it was controlled reverts to the original internal value without warning.
findings.enforcement: Pin ownership at mount and warn on transitions, or define an explicit reset/handoff API.

resolution.detail: Controlled ownership is fixed at mount with a warning on attempted handoff.

findings.invariant: A rejected open change leaves the web accordion in its controlled state.
findings.observed: Native details toggles its own open property; the wrapper only notifies onToggle. With open=false and a parent that declines the change, the DOM can remain open.
findings.enforcement: Control the summary activation and restore the committed open state when the host declines the request, matching native controlled behavior.

resolution.detail: Accordion summary activation requests a state change; native DOM toggles are reconciled to committed state.

findings.invariant: Field label, description and error refer to the actual input.
findings.observed: Input/TextArea spread child props after contextual id/aria-describedby/aria-invalid/required. A different child id detaches the label; multiple inputs under one Field reuse its id.
findings.enforcement: Define one control per Field, reserve or merge the naming/validation attributes, and validate conflicting ids in development.

resolution.detail: Field controls keep contextual identity, descriptions, required and error state; duplicate controls are rejected.

findings.invariant: The selected tab remains an available item as the list changes.
findings.observed: Removing the initially selected tab from uncontrolled Tabs leaves every panel hidden. Disabled selected tabs can retain selection too.
findings.enforcement: Reconcile uncontrolled selection on removal/disable. For controlled invalid values, warn or show an explicit invalid/empty state instead of silently implying a valid selection.

resolution.detail: Uncontrolled tabs reconcile missing/disabled selections; controlled invalid values remain empty.

findings.invariant: A forwarded callback ref preserves React cleanup semantics.
findings.observed: SearchInput wraps its ref when onClear is supplied, calls the host callback but drops its cleanup return. The cleanup is not run on unmount; native uses the same forwarding pattern.
findings.enforcement: Compose refs with callback cleanup support and stable identity, as GestureSheet already does.

resolution.detail: SearchInput composes callback-ref cleanup and uses a stable callback.

findings.invariant: Time values are valid representable instants or finite countdown durations.
findings.observed: formatCountdown(NaN) produces NaN clock text. formatZonedTime accepts a finite value such as 1e20 but Intl throws because it is outside Date range. Locale/zone/format options are also not generally validated.
findings.enforcement: Validate finite durations, representable Date range and external locale/time-zone/options at their boundary; define an unknown/error display consistently.

resolution.detail: Invalid or unrepresentable dates, durations and Intl options return the unknown marker.

findings.invariant: Distinct source/id/intent tuples remain distinct deduplication keys.
findings.observed: Joining strings with slashes collides: source a/b + id c equals source a + id b/c, suppressing the second valid event.
findings.enforcement: Use nested maps or an unambiguous tuple encoding such as JSON.stringify([source,id,intent]).

resolution.detail: Feedback keys encode source/id/intent as JSON tuples.

findings.invariant: A fixed sheet has at least one usable detent after normalization.
findings.observed: gesture-sheet-next only checks raw array length. [0,-1,NaN] passes that boundary, while detentHeights returns no positions. The surface then has no valid place to open.
findings.enforcement: Validate each detent and ensure normalized geometry contains a positive detent; clamp the initial index against normalized detent count.

resolution.detail: Both native sheet backends validate detents and initial indexes; resolved detent indexes are clamped.

findings.invariant: The newest preference update remains newest in storage.
findings.observed: FeedbackProvider starts each storage.write independently. A slower old write can finish after a newer write and overwrite it. The read revision guard does not order writes.
findings.enforcement: Serialize/coalesce writes or require a revision-aware storage adapter that rejects stale writes.

resolution.detail: Preference storage writes run serially and recover from rejected writes.

findings.invariant: The selection displayed is the selection held by the app.
findings.observed: When a controlled value is absent from options, Select shows and marks the first enabled option as selected without committing that value or notifying the host.
findings.enforcement: Render a placeholder/invalid selection for unmatched controlled values; reconcile uncontrolled lists explicitly.

resolution.detail: Select no longer displays an uncommitted fallback for a controlled missing selection.

findings.invariant: A displayed complete account total contains no unknown holdings.
findings.observed: Unknown per-asset values become zero in the total. One known holding of 5 plus an unknown holding produces a total of 5 without marking it partial.
findings.enforcement: Propagate unknown or return total plus completeness metadata, and show partial totals explicitly.

resolution.detail: Unknown and nonfinite asset values propagate into aggregate totals.

findings.invariant: Unsubscribing prevents future updates from that subscription.
findings.observed: bitcoinPrice cleanup closes the socket but onmessage never checks stopped/current socket. A late frame after cleanup still invokes onPrice. Chart feed callbacks also have no generation guard.
findings.enforcement: Detach handlers or guard them with active subscription identity; add a generation guard in chart consumers when replacing feeds.

resolution.detail: Feed callbacks and consumers reject stale/unsubscribed generations.

findings.invariant: Visible slippage text matches the effective valid tolerance, or is clearly invalid.
findings.observed: Typing 99 leaves 99 in the field but does not update the old tolerance and shows no validation error. parseFloat also accepts a valid prefix of malformed multi-dot text.
findings.enforcement: Validate the entire decimal, display an error for invalid drafts, and prevent continuing until the effective setting and visible text agree.

resolution.detail: Slippage rejects malformed/out-of-range drafts and resets incomplete drafts on blur/back.

findings.invariant: An async result is still relevant to the active owner when announced.
findings.observed: WalletAddress can publish a global success toast after its screen has unmounted. InstallCommand and swap copy handlers have similar unguarded asynchronous reporting.
findings.enforcement: Track mount/operation generation, cancel or ignore superseded completions, and decide explicitly whether results should survive navigation.

resolution.detail: Async copy results are scoped to a mounted owner and the latest operation.

findings.invariant: The data visible during submission refers to the same immutable operation the host is executing.
findings.observed: submitting locks the primary action and some amount inputs, but pair flip, token pickers, destination edit and denomination controls remain callable. A submitting swap can still invoke onFromChange.
findings.enforcement: Freeze operation-affecting controls or make the host capture an immutable operation snapshot and present edits as a separate draft. Do not read mutable UI state after awaits.

resolution.detail: Submission blocks operation-changing controls. Execution snapshot and idempotency remain host responsibilities.

findings.invariant: Slider/progress/pagination inputs define finite, coherent ranges.
findings.observed: Native Slider divides by step without requiring it > 0; step=0 makes its accessible increment NaN. Progress may expose raw out-of-range values to accessibility while clamping its fill. Pagination accepts noninteger/out-of-range page and total.
findings.enforcement: Centralize finite range validation, define zero-step continuous behavior, and use normalized values consistently for visuals, callbacks and accessibility.

resolution.detail: Slider validates ranges/step; progress and pagination normalize drawing, accessibility and callbacks.

findings.invariant: IDs used for state, DOM naming and React keys are unique and stable.
findings.observed: OutcomeChart caps count but does not deduplicate ids; two outcomes can share one animation track while rendering two capsules. Tabs, selection controls, List and Table similarly trust host keys.
findings.enforcement: Validate identity at collection boundaries (development assertions at minimum). OutcomeChart should reject/deduplicate duplicate IDs as AltimeterChart already does for targets.

resolution.detail: Collection boundaries reject duplicate keys; OutcomeChart deduplicates outcome IDs.

findings.invariant: Visual effects cannot allocate unbounded synchronous work from a valid option.
findings.observed: createConfettiBurst caps particleCount at Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, then synchronously creates one object per particle. Both renderers also permit accumulating bursts; the numeric cap is not a practical resource limit.
findings.enforcement: Set a documented per-burst and total-active particle budget, bound concurrent bursts, and resolve dropped/cancelled effects deterministically.

resolution.detail: Confetti caps each burst at 500 particles and simultaneous/pre-mount bursts at eight.

findings.invariant: A chart presented as live has a current connection and recent data.
findings.observed: The built-in feeds reconnect on close, but have no stale-message deadline/heartbeat state; a socket that remains open without data keeps the last price displayed indefinitely. No freshness state accompanies the price callback.
findings.enforcement: Carry observedAt/connection status, define a stale threshold and reconnect policy, and render stale/unknown state separately from live values.
findings.owner: HIG feed and host data policy

resolution.detail: Thirty-second freshness deadlines clear stale prices and mark the chart stale; built-in streams reconnect.

findings.invariant: Only the active panel responds to global shortcuts and amount capture.
findings.observed: Each mounted SwapPanelBlock registers window shortcuts by default. The shortcut branch does not check event.defaultPrevented or active panel ownership, so retained/hidden or multiple panels can all react.
findings.enforcement: Register global handlers only for the active visible panel or use a central shortcut owner/stack, and honor already-handled events.

resolution.detail: One visible active panel owns global input, honors handled events, and supports active=false.

hostResponsibilities.invariant: Execution revalidates the exact amount, spendable balance, fees, minimums and chain/recipient constraints.
hostResponsibilities.reason: HIG is presentation code. TradeEntry, ConfirmBlock and SwapPanelBlock delegate execution and validation to host callbacks; enabled buttons are not authorization.

hostResponsibilities.invariant: A quote is bound to asset identity, chain, amount, recipient, slippage and expiry.
hostResponsibilities.reason: HIG receives independent display props and has no quote revision/expiry token or atomic operation object.

hostResponsibilities.invariant: One operation is executed once, even across double taps, retries, app backgrounding and process restarts.
hostResponsibilities.reason: busy/submitting are host-provided UI state, not a transaction mutex or server idempotency key.

hostResponsibilities.invariant: Wallet address text, QR payload, network and copy callback all represent the same intended destination.
hostResponsibilities.reason: The API deliberately permits distinct qrValue/custom QR and arbitrary clipboard adapter; semantic binding must happen in the host.

hostResponsibilities.invariant: Optional native/gesture/font dependencies and providers match the installed runtime.
hostResponsibilities.reason: HIG cannot prove that externally supplied font registration, safe area/gesture/portal providers and platform color-space setup actually exist; package/type checks are not runtime capability proofs.

hostResponsibilitiesNote: Execution policies are documented in docs/components/blocks.md; no backend or application transaction implementation is present in this repository.
